{# ==================================================================================== #}
{# 1. ARCHITECTURAL DOCUMENTATION & DEFENSIVE UNIT / ADDRESS RESOLUTION ENGINE          #}
{# ==================================================================================== #}
{#
   BUSINESS CONTEXT & DATA ARCHITECTURE (CEPH LIFESCIENCES / COVALENT LABORATORIES):
   1. Warehouse Master Topology (`Warehouse.csv`):
      - Unit-1 leaf warehouses carry "- U1 - CLPL" (Parent: "Unit-1 - CLPL", custom_unit: "Unit-1").
      - Unit-2 leaf warehouses carry NO unit token in their name, e.g., "Raw Materials - CLPL",
        "Packing Materials - CLPL", "Finished Goods - CLPL" (Parent: "Unit-2 - CLPL", custom_unit: "Unit-2").
      - Unit-6 leaf warehouses carry "- U6 (Baddi) - CLPL" (Parent: "Unit-6 - CLPL", custom_unit: "Unit-6").
      Therefore, string matching alone FAILS for Unit-2. We MUST query `Warehouse.custom_unit`
      and `Warehouse.parent_warehouse` first before falling back to normalized token matching.
   2. Address Master Topology (`ERPNext Customization Manifest.csv`):
      - `Address` contains `custom_unit` (Link: Unit), `custom_company` (Link: Company),
        `custom_address_line_3`, `custom_address_line_4`, `custom_dl_nos`, `custom_pan_no`,
        `custom_contact_person`, `custom_contact_phno`, `gstin`, `gst_state`, `gst_state_number`.
   3. Stock Entry Customizations:
      - Header: `unit`, `ge_external_transfer`, `ge_gate_pass_instruction`, `gate_pass`,
        `custom_production_batch`, `ewaybill`, `bill_from_address`, `bill_to_address`,
        `ship_from_address`, `ship_to_address`, `transporter_name`, `vehicle_no`, `lr_no`, `lr_date`, `distance`.
      - Detail: `gst_hsn_code`, `taxable_value`, `cgst_rate`, `cgst_amount`, `sgst_rate`,
        `sgst_amount`, `igst_rate`, `igst_amount`, `cess_amount`, `unit`, `product`.
#}

{% set comp_name = doc.get('company') or frappe.defaults.get_user_default('Company') %}
{% set c_doc = frappe.get_doc("Company", comp_name) if (comp_name and frappe.db.exists("Company", comp_name)) else None %}
{% set c_logo = (c_doc.get('company_logo') if c_doc else "") or "" %}

{# Helper Macro: Normalize any candidate string into canonical Unit-1, Unit-2, Unit-3, Unit-4, Unit-5, or Unit-6 #}
{% macro normalize_unit_token(raw_val) -%}
    {% set norm = (" " ~ (raw_val | string | upper) ~ " ")
        | replace("UNIT-III", "UNIT-3") | replace("UNIT III", "UNIT-3")
        | replace("UNIT-II", "UNIT-2")  | replace("UNIT II", "UNIT-2")
        | replace("UNIT-VI", "UNIT-6")  | replace("UNIT VI", "UNIT-6")
        | replace("UNIT-IV", "UNIT-4")  | replace("UNIT IV", "UNIT-4")
        | replace("UNIT-V", "UNIT-5")   | replace("UNIT V", "UNIT-5")
        | replace("UNIT-I", "UNIT-1")   | replace("UNIT I", "UNIT-1")
        | replace("UNIT 1", "UNIT-1")   | replace("UNIT 2", "UNIT-2")
        | replace("UNIT 3", "UNIT-3")   | replace("UNIT 4", "UNIT-4")
        | replace("UNIT 5", "UNIT-5")   | replace("UNIT 6", "UNIT-6")
        | replace("- U1 -", " UNIT-1 ") | replace(" U1 ", " UNIT-1 ")
        | replace("- U2 -", " UNIT-2 ") | replace(" U2 ", " UNIT-2 ")
        | replace("- U3 -", " UNIT-3 ") | replace(" U3 ", " UNIT-3 ")
        | replace("- U6", " UNIT-6 ")   | replace(" U6 ", " UNIT-6 ")
        | replace("BADDI", " UNIT-6 ") -%}
    {% if "UNIT-1" in norm %}Unit-1
    {%- elif "UNIT-2" in norm %}Unit-2
    {%- elif "UNIT-3" in norm %}Unit-3
    {%- elif "UNIT-4" in norm %}Unit-4
    {%- elif "UNIT-5" in norm %}Unit-5
    {%- elif "UNIT-6" in norm %}Unit-6
    {%- else %}{%- endif %}
{%- endmacro %}

{# Scan Stock Entry Header & Detail Rows for Source and Target Warehouses #}
{% set wh_scan = namespace(src_wh=doc.get('from_warehouse') or '', dest_wh=doc.get('to_warehouse') or '', src_row_unit='', dest_row_unit='', all_src_wh=[], all_dest_wh=[]) %}
{% if doc.get('items') %}
    {% for r in doc.items %}
        {% set sw = (r.get('s_warehouse') or '') | string | trim %}
        {% set tw = (r.get('t_warehouse') or '') | string | trim %}
        {% if sw %}
            {% if not wh_scan.src_wh %}{% set wh_scan.src_wh = sw %}{% endif %}
            {% if sw not in wh_scan.all_src_wh %}{% set wh_scan.all_src_wh = wh_scan.all_src_wh + [sw] %}{% endif %}
            {% if not wh_scan.src_row_unit and r.get('unit') %}{% set wh_scan.src_row_unit = r.get('unit') %}{% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if tw %}
            {% if not wh_scan.dest_wh %}{% set wh_scan.dest_wh = tw %}{% endif %}
            {% if tw not in wh_scan.all_dest_wh %}{% set wh_scan.all_dest_wh = wh_scan.all_dest_wh + [tw] %}{% endif %}
            {% if not wh_scan.dest_row_unit and r.get('unit') %}{% set wh_scan.dest_row_unit = r.get('unit') %}{% endif %}
        {% endif %}
    {% endfor %}
{% endif %}

{# 5-Tier Deterministic Warehouse-to-Unit Deduction Macro #}
{% macro deduce_unit_from_context(wh_name, explicit_addr_name, fallback_row_unit, fallback_hdr_unit) -%}
    {% set u_ns = namespace(resolved="") %}

    {# Tier 1 & 2: Direct Indexed DB Lookup on `tabWarehouse` (`custom_unit` & `parent_warehouse`) #}
    {% if wh_name and frappe.db.exists("Warehouse", wh_name) %}
        {% set wh_meta = frappe.db.get_value("Warehouse", wh_name, ["custom_unit", "parent_warehouse", "warehouse_name"], as_dict=1) %}
        {% if wh_meta %}
            {% if wh_meta.get("custom_unit") %}
                {% set u_ns.resolved = ( normalize_unit_token(wh_meta.get("custom_unit")) | trim ) or (wh_meta.get("custom_unit") | string | trim) %}
            {% endif %}
            {% if not u_ns.resolved and wh_meta.get("parent_warehouse") %}
                {% set u_ns.resolved = normalize_unit_token(wh_meta.get("parent_warehouse")) | trim %}
                {% if not u_ns.resolved and frappe.db.exists("Warehouse", wh_meta.get("parent_warehouse")) %}
                    {% set p_unit = frappe.db.get_value("Warehouse", wh_meta.get("parent_warehouse"), "custom_unit") %}
                    {% if p_unit %}
                        {% set u_ns.resolved = (normalize_unit_token(p_unit) | trim) or (p_unit | string | trim) %}
                    {% endif %}
                {% endif %}
            {% endif %}
            {% if not u_ns.resolved and wh_meta.get("warehouse_name") %}
                {% set u_ns.resolved = normalize_unit_token(wh_meta.get("warehouse_name")) | trim %}
            {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
    {% endif %}

    {# Tier 3: Token Match on Raw Warehouse ID #}
    {% if not u_ns.resolved and wh_name %}
        {% set u_ns.resolved = normalize_unit_token(wh_name) | trim %}
    {% endif %}

    {# Tier 4: Explicit Address Link (`ship_from_address` / `ship_to_address` / `bill_from_address` / `bill_to_address`) #}
    {% if not u_ns.resolved and explicit_addr_name and frappe.db.exists("Address", explicit_addr_name) %}
        {% set addr_u = frappe.db.get_value("Address", explicit_addr_name, "custom_unit") %}
        {% set u_ns.resolved = (normalize_unit_token(addr_u or explicit_addr_name) | trim) or (addr_u | string | trim) %}
    {% endif %}

    {# Tier 5: Accounting Dimension (`row.unit` or `doc.unit`) #}
    {% if not u_ns.resolved and fallback_row_unit %}
        {% set u_ns.resolved = (normalize_unit_token(fallback_row_unit) | trim) or (fallback_row_unit | string | trim) %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if not u_ns.resolved and fallback_hdr_unit %}
        {% set u_ns.resolved = (normalize_unit_token(fallback_hdr_unit) | trim) or (fallback_hdr_unit | string | trim) %}
    {% endif %}

    {{ u_ns.resolved }}
{%- endmacro %}

{% set src_explicit_addr = (doc.get('ship_from_address') or doc.get('bill_from_address') or '') | string | trim %}
{% set dest_explicit_addr = (doc.get('ship_to_address') or doc.get('bill_to_address') or '') | string | trim %}

{% set src_unit = deduce_unit_from_context(wh_scan.src_wh, src_explicit_addr, wh_scan.src_row_unit, doc.get('unit')) | trim %}
{% set dest_unit = deduce_unit_from_context(wh_scan.dest_wh, dest_explicit_addr, wh_scan.dest_row_unit, '') | trim %}

{# Bilateral Unit Inference: If transferring between Unit-1 and Unit-2 and one side is still blank, infer counterpart #}
{% if not src_unit and dest_unit == 'Unit-2' %}{% set src_unit = 'Unit-1' %}
{% elif not src_unit and dest_unit == 'Unit-1' %}{% set src_unit = 'Unit-2' %}
{% elif not dest_unit and src_unit == 'Unit-1' and wh_scan.dest_wh %}{% set dest_unit = 'Unit-2' %}
{% elif not dest_unit and src_unit == 'Unit-2' and wh_scan.dest_wh %}{% set dest_unit = 'Unit-1' %}
{% endif %}

{# 4-Tier Plant Address Resolution Engine (Returns exact Address DocName for a given Unit) #}
{% macro resolve_unit_address_name(company_val, target_unit_val, preferred_addr_name) -%}
    {% set a_ns = namespace(matched_name="") %}

    {# Priority 1: Use Explicit Address on Stock Entry ONLY if its Unit matches `target_unit_val` (or if `target_unit_val` is empty) #}
    {% if preferred_addr_name and frappe.db.exists("Address", preferred_addr_name) %}
        {% if not target_unit_val %}
            {% set a_ns.matched_name = preferred_addr_name %}
        {% else %}
            {% set pref_u_raw = frappe.db.get_value("Address", preferred_addr_name, "custom_unit") or "" %}
            {% set pref_u_norm = normalize_unit_token(pref_u_raw ~ " " ~ preferred_addr_name) | trim %}
            {% if pref_u_norm == target_unit_val or (pref_u_raw | string | trim) == target_unit_val %}
                {% set a_ns.matched_name = preferred_addr_name %}
            {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
    {% endif %}

    {# Priority 2: Direct Query on `tabAddress` by `custom_unit` & `custom_company` / `is_your_company_address` #}
    {% if not a_ns.matched_name and target_unit_val %}
        {% set direct_addrs = frappe.get_all(
            "Address",
            filters={"custom_unit": target_unit_val, "disabled": 0},
            fields=["name", "custom_company", "is_your_company_address"],
            order_by="is_your_company_address desc, modified desc",
            limit_page_length=10
        ) %}
        {% for da in direct_addrs %}
            {% if not a_ns.matched_name and (da.custom_company == company_val or da.is_your_company_address == 1 or not da.custom_company) %}
                {% set a_ns.matched_name = da.name %}
            {% endif %}
        {% endfor %}
    {% endif %}

    {# Priority 3: Dynamic Link Traversal on `Company` Addresses matching `target_unit_val` #}
    {% if not a_ns.matched_name and company_val %}
        {% set comp_links = frappe.get_all(
            "Dynamic Link",
            filters={"parenttype": "Address", "link_doctype": "Company", "link_name": company_val},
            fields=["parent"]
        ) %}
        {% for dl in comp_links %}
            {% if not a_ns.matched_name and frappe.db.exists("Address", dl.parent) %}
                {% set dl_addr = frappe.db.get_value("Address", dl.parent, ["custom_unit", "address_title", "address_line1", "address_line2", "disabled"], as_dict=1) %}
                {% if dl_addr and not dl_addr.get("disabled") %}
                    {% set cand_str = (dl.parent ~ " " ~ (dl_addr.get("custom_unit") or "") ~ " " ~ (dl_addr.get("address_title") or "") ~ " " ~ (dl_addr.get("address_line1") or "")) %}
                    {% set dl_norm = normalize_unit_token(cand_str) | trim %}
                    {% if target_unit_val and dl_norm == target_unit_val %}
                        {% set a_ns.matched_name = dl.parent %}
                    {% endif %}
                {% endif %}
            {% endif %}
        {% endfor %}
        {# Fallback to explicit preferred address if no unit-specific address record exists in DB #}
        {% if not a_ns.matched_name and preferred_addr_name and frappe.db.exists("Address", preferred_addr_name) %}
            {% set a_ns.matched_name = preferred_addr_name %}
        {% endif %}
        {# Fallback to first active Company Address #}
        {% if not a_ns.matched_name and comp_links %}
            {% for dl in comp_links %}
                {% if not a_ns.matched_name and frappe.db.exists("Address", dl.parent) %}
                    {% set a_ns.matched_name = dl.parent %}
                {% endif %}
            {% endfor %}
        {% endif %}
    {% endif %}

    {{ a_ns.matched_name }}
{%- endmacro %}

{% set src_addr_name = resolve_unit_address_name(comp_name, src_unit, src_explicit_addr) | trim %}
{% set dest_addr_name = resolve_unit_address_name(comp_name, dest_unit, dest_explicit_addr) | trim %}

{% set src_addr_doc = frappe.get_doc("Address", src_addr_name) if (src_addr_name and frappe.db.exists("Address", src_addr_name)) else None %}
{% set dest_addr_doc = frappe.get_doc("Address", dest_addr_name) if (dest_addr_name and frappe.db.exists("Address", dest_addr_name)) else None %}

{% if src_addr_doc %}

{% set src_wrk_clean = (src_addr_raw ~ '')

{% if src_wrk_clean.endswith(',') %}{% set src_wrk_clean = src_wrk_clean[:-1] | trim %}{% endif %}

{% set src_gstin = (src_addr_doc.get('gstin') if src_addr_doc else '') or doc.get('bill_from_gstin') or (c_doc.get('gstin') if c_doc else '') or '-' %}
{% set src_pan = src_gstin[2:12] if (src_gstin and src_gstin | length >= 12) else ((src_addr_doc.get('custom_pan_no') if src_addr_doc else '') or (c_doc.get('pan') if c_doc else '') or '-') %}
{% set src_st_name = ((src_addr_doc.get('gst_state') or src_addr_doc.get('state')) if src_addr_doc else '') or '-' %}
{% set src_st_code = (src_addr_doc.get('gst_state_number') if src_addr_doc else '') or (src_gstin[0:2] if (src_gstin and src_gstin | length >= 2) else '-') %}

{% set src_cp = (src_addr_doc.get('custom_contact_person') if src_addr_doc else '') or '' %}
{% set src_ph = (src_addr_doc.get('custom_contact_phno') or src_addr_doc.get('phone') if src_addr_doc else '') or (c_doc.get('phone_no') if c_doc else '') or '-' %}
{% set comp_cin = (c_doc.get('custom_company_cin') if c_doc else '') or '-' %}

{# Format Clean Works Address Text & Statutory Fields for Destination Plant #}
{% set dest_addr_raw = "" %}
{% if dest_addr_doc %}
    {% set dest_addr_raw = [
        dest_addr_doc.address_line1,
        dest_addr_doc.address_line2,
        dest_addr_doc.get('custom_address_line_3'),

        (dest_addr_doc.pincode ~ '') if dest_addr_doc.pincode else ''

{% if not dest_addr_raw %}

{% endif %}
{% set dest_wrk_clean = (dest_addr_raw ~ '')

    | replace('Ceph Lifesciences Private LTD, ', '')
    | replace('Ceph Lifesciences Private Limited, ', '')
    | replace('THE. DERABASSI', 'TEH. DERABASSI')
    | replace('The. Derabassi', 'Teh. Derabassi')
    | replace(', ,', ',') | replace(',,', ',') | trim %}
{% if dest_wrk_clean.endswith(',') %}{% set dest_wrk_clean = dest_wrk_clean[:-1] | trim %}{% endif %}

{% set dest_gstin = (dest_addr_doc.get('gstin') if dest_addr_doc else '') or doc.get('bill_to_gstin') or src_gstin or '-' %}
{% set dest_pan = dest_gstin[2:12] if (dest_gstin and dest_gstin | length >= 12) else ((dest_addr_doc.get('custom_pan_no') if dest_addr_doc else '') or src_pan) %}

{% set dest_st_code = (dest_addr_doc.get('gst_state_number') if dest_addr_doc else '') or (dest_gstin[0:2] if (dest_gstin and dest_gstin | length >= 2) else src_st_code) %}
{% set dest_dl = (dest_addr_doc.get('custom_dl_nos') if dest_addr_doc else '') or '-' %}
{% set dest_cp = (dest_addr_doc.get('custom_contact_person') if dest_addr_doc else '') or '' %}
{% set dest_ph = (dest_addr_doc.get('custom_contact_phno') or dest_addr_doc.get('phone') if dest_addr_doc else '') or '-' %}

{# Registered Office Resolution #}
{% set reg_off = (c_doc.get('custom_registered_office_address') if c_doc else '') or '' %}
{% if not reg_off and comp_name %}
    {% set reg_addr_id = frappe.db.get_value("Address", {"is_your_company_address": 1, "address_type": "Billing"}, "name") or frappe.db.get_value("Address", {"is_your_company_address": 1}, "name") %}
    {% if reg_addr_id and frappe.db.exists("Address", reg_addr_id) %}
        {% set r_doc = frappe.get_doc("Address", reg_addr_id) %}
        {% set reg_off = [
            r_doc.address_line1,
            r_doc.address_line2,
            r_doc.get('custom_address_line_3'),
            r_doc.get('custom_address_line_4'),
            r_doc.city,
            r_doc.state,
            (r_doc.pincode ~ '') if r_doc.pincode else '',
            r_doc.country
        ] | select | join(', ') %}
    {% endif %}
{% endif %}

{# Pre-Scan GST Taxes on Stock Entry / Stock Entry Detail #}
{% set is_inter_gstin = True if (src_gstin != '-' and dest_gstin != '-' and src_gstin != dest_gstin) else False %}
{% set gst_ns = namespace(cg_amt=0.0, sg_amt=0.0, ig_amt=0.0, cess_amt=0.0, tot_tax=0.0) %}
{% if doc.get('taxes') %}
    {% for t in doc.taxes %}
        {% set g_type = (t.get('gst_tax_type') or '') | string | lower | trim %}
        {% set desc = ((t.description or '') ~ ' ' ~ (t.account_head or '')) | upper %}
        {% set t_val = (t.get('base_tax_amount_after_discount_amount') or t.get('base_tax_amount') or t.get('tax_amount') or 0.0) | float %}
        {% if g_type == 'cgst' or 'CGST' in desc %}
            {% set gst_ns.cg_amt = gst_ns.cg_amt + t_val %}
            {% set gst_ns.tot_tax = gst_ns.tot_tax + t_val %}
        {% elif g_type in ['sgst', 'utgst', 'ugst'] or 'SGST' in desc or 'UTGST' in desc %}
            {% set gst_ns.sg_amt = gst_ns.sg_amt + t_val %}
            {% set gst_ns.tot_tax = gst_ns.tot_tax + t_val %}
        {% elif g_type == 'igst' or 'IGST' in desc %}
            {% set gst_ns.ig_amt = gst_ns.ig_amt + t_val %}
            {% set gst_ns.tot_tax = gst_ns.tot_tax + t_val %}
        {% elif g_type in ['cess', 'cess_non_advol'] or 'CESS' in desc %}
            {% set gst_ns.cess_amt = gst_ns.cess_amt + t_val %}
            {% set gst_ns.tot_tax = gst_ns.tot_tax + t_val %}
        {% endif %}
    {% endfor %}
{% endif %}

{# Clean Warehouse Display Names (Strip redundant '- CLPL' suffix for visual clarity) #}
{% set src_wh_display = (wh_scan.all_src_wh | join(', ')) | replace(' - CLPL', '') %}
{% set dest_wh_display = (wh_scan.all_dest_wh | join(', ')) | replace(' - CLPL', '') %}

<table class="doc-banner">
    <tr>
        <td style="width: 30%; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: bold;">

        </td>
        <td style="width: 40%;">
            <div class="doc-title">INTER-UNIT STOCK TRANSFER CHALLAN</div>
            <div class="doc-subtitle">
                ({{ src_unit or 'SOURCE UNIT' }} TO {{ dest_unit or 'RECEIVING UNIT' }} — MANDATORY GxP MATERIAL MOVEMENT CUM GATE PASS)
            </div>
        </td>
        <td style="width: 30%; font-size: 8pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: right;">
            Original for Transporter / Receiving Store
        </td>
    </tr>
</table>

        <col style="width: 50%;">
        <col style="width: 50%;">
    </colgroup>
    <tr>
        <!-- LEFT QUADRANT: DISPATCHING PLANT (SOURCE UNIT) -->
        <td style="padding: 4px 6px !important;">
            <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse;">
                <tr>
                    <td style="border: none !important; padding: 0 !important; vertical-align: top !important;">
                        <div class="lbl-muted">Dispatching Plant / Consignor (From Unit)</div>
                        <div class="txt-xl">{{ comp_name }} <span class="unit-badge">{{ src_unit or 'Unassigned' }}</span></div>
                    </td>
                    {% if c_logo %}
                    <td style="border: none !important; padding: 0 !important; text-align: right; vertical-align: top !important; width: 28%;">
                        <img src="{{ c_logo }}" style="max-height: 34px; max-width: 110px; object-fit: contain;" alt="Logo">
                    </td>
                    {% endif %}
                </tr>
            </table>
            <hr class="hr-compact">
            <div style="line-height: 1.28;">
                <div><strong>Source Warehouse:</strong> <strong>{{ src_wh_display or '-' }}</strong></div>
                <div><strong>Plant Works:</strong> {{ src_wrk_clean or 'Address Not Mapped for ' ~ (src_unit or 'Source Unit') }}</div>
                <div><strong>State:</strong> {{ src_st_name }}<span class="sep">|</span><strong>State Code:</strong> {{ src_st_code }}</div>
                <div><strong>GSTIN:</strong> <strong>{{ src_gstin }}</strong><span class="sep">|</span><strong>PAN:</strong> {{ src_pan }}</div>
                <div><strong>Drug Lic. (DL Nos.):</strong> <strong>{{ src_dl }}</strong><span class="sep">|</span><strong>CIN:</strong> {{ comp_cin }}</div>
                <div>
                    <strong>Contact:</strong> {{ src_ph }}
                    {% if src_cp %}<span class="sep">|</span><strong>Person:</strong> {{ src_cp }}{% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
        </td>

        <!-- RIGHT QUADRANT: RECEIVING PLANT (DESTINATION UNIT) -->
        <td style="padding: 4px 6px !important;">
            <div class="lbl-muted">Receiving Plant / Consignee (To Unit)</div>
            <div class="txt-xl">{{ comp_name }} <span class="unit-badge">{{ dest_unit or 'Unassigned' }}</span></div>
            <hr class="hr-compact">
            <div style="line-height: 1.28;">
                <div><strong>Target Warehouse:</strong> <strong>{{ dest_wh_display or '-' }}</strong></div>
                <div><strong>Plant Works:</strong> {{ dest_wrk_clean or 'Address Not Mapped for ' ~ (dest_unit or 'Receiving Unit') }}</div>
                <div><strong>State:</strong> {{ dest_st_name }}<span class="sep">|</span><strong>State Code:</strong> {{ dest_st_code }}</div>
                <div><strong>GSTIN:</strong> <strong>{{ dest_gstin }}</strong><span class="sep">|</span><strong>PAN:</strong> {{ dest_pan }}</div>
                <div>
                    <strong>Drug Lic. (DL Nos.):</strong> <strong>{{ dest_dl }}</strong>
                    <span class="sep">|</span><strong>Regime:</strong> <strong>{{ "Inter-GSTIN Taxable" if is_inter_gstin else "Intra-GSTIN Challan" }}</strong>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <strong>Contact:</strong> {{ dest_ph }}
                    {% if dest_cp %}<span class="sep">|</span><strong>Person:</strong> {{ dest_cp }}{% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
        </td>
    </tr>
</table>

<!-- ==================================================================================== -->
<!-- SECTION B: VOUCHER, TRANSPORT, E-WAYBILL & GATE PASS METADATA (28% / 36% / 36%)      -->
<!-- ==================================================================================== -->
{% set first_mr = (doc.items[0].get('material_request') | string | trim) if (doc.items and doc.items[0].get('material_request')) else '' %}
{% set hdr_cc = (doc.get('cost_center') or (doc.items[0].get('cost_center') if doc.items else '') or src_unit or '-') | replace(' - CLPL', '') | replace(' - CEPH', '') %}

<table class="header-table">
    <colgroup>
        <col style="width: 28%;">
        <col style="width: 36%;">
        <col style="width: 36%;">
    </colgroup>
    <tr>
        <td>
            <div><strong>CHALLAN / STE NO.:</strong> <span class="txt-xl" style="margin-left: 2px;">{{ doc.get('name') }}</span></div>
            <div>
                <strong>Date:</strong> <strong>{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.get('posting_date'), 'dd.MM.yyyy') if doc.get('posting_date') else '-' }}</strong>
                <span class="sep">|</span><strong>Time:</strong> {{ frappe.utils.format_time(doc.get('posting_time'), 'HH:mm') if doc.get('posting_time') else '-' }}
            </div>
            <hr class="hr-compact">
            <div><strong>Transfer Type:</strong> <strong>{{ doc.get('stock_entry_type') or doc.get('purpose') or 'Material Transfer' }}</strong></div>
            <div>
                <strong>External Movement:</strong> <strong>{{ "Yes (Inter-Premises)" if (doc.get('ge_external_transfer') or src_unit != dest_unit) else "Internal" }}</strong>
            </div>
        </td>
        <td>
            <div>
                <strong>e-Waybill No.:</strong> <span class="txt-mono"><strong>{{ doc.get('ewaybill') or 'Not Applicable / Pending' }}</strong></span>
            </div>
            <div>
                <strong>Transporter:</strong> {{ (doc.get('transporter_name') or doc.get('transporter') or 'Company / Own Vehicle') | replace('Main Address', '') | trim }}
                {% if doc.get('gst_transporter_id') %}<span class="sep">|</span><strong>ID:</strong> {{ doc.get('gst_transporter_id') }}{% endif %}
            </div>
            <hr class="hr-compact">
            <div>
                <strong>Vehicle No.:</strong> <strong>{{ doc.get('vehicle_no') or '-' }}</strong>
                <span class="sep">|</span><strong>Mode:</strong> {{ doc.get('mode_of_transport') or 'Road' }}
                {% if doc.get('distance') %}<span class="sep">|</span><strong>Dist.:</strong> {{ doc.get('distance') }} km{% endif %}
            </div>
            <div>
                <strong>GR / LR No.:</strong> {{ doc.get('lr_no') or '-' }}
                {% if doc.get('lr_date') %}<span class="sep">|</span><strong>LR Date:</strong> {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.get('lr_date'), 'dd.MM.yyyy') }}{% endif %}
            </div>
        </td>
        <td>
            <div>
                <strong>Gate Pass No.:</strong> <strong>{{ doc.get('gate_pass') or '-' }}</strong>
                {% if first_mr %}<span class="sep">|</span><strong>Indent / MR:</strong> {{ first_mr }}{% endif %}
            </div>
            <div>
                <strong>Production Batch Ref.:</strong> <strong>{{ doc.get('custom_production_batch') or doc.get('work_order') or '-' }}</strong>
            </div>
            <hr class="hr-compact">
            <div>
                <strong>Place of Supply:</strong> {{ doc.get('place_of_supply') or dest_st_name or '-' }}
            </div>
            <div>
                <strong>Cost Center:</strong> {{ hdr_cc }}
                {% if doc.get('product') %}<span class="sep">|</span><strong>FG Product:</strong> {{ doc.get('product') }}{% endif %}
            </div>
        </td>
    </tr>
</table>

<!-- ==================================================================================== -->
<!-- SECTION C: MULTI-TIER GxP BATCH, AR TRACEABILITY & VALUATION TABLE                   -->
<!-- ==================================================================================== -->
{% set def_uom = doc.items[0].get('uom') if doc.items else 'Kg' %}
{% set uom_pre = namespace(list=[]) %}
{% if doc.items %}
    {% for r_pre in doc.items %}
        {% set u_p = (r_pre.get('uom') or def_uom) | string | trim %}
        {% if u_p not in uom_pre.list %}{% set uom_pre.list = uom_pre.list + [u_p] %}{% endif %}
    {% endfor %}
{% endif %}
{% set is_mixed_uom = (uom_pre.list | length > 1) %}

<table class="pr-table">
    <colgroup>
        <col style="width: 4.5%;">  <!-- 1. Sr. -->
        <col style="width: 23.5%;"> <!-- 2. Material Description & Code -->
        <col style="width: 9.5%;">  <!-- 3. HSN/SAC -->
        <col style="width: 17.5%;"> <!-- 4. Batch No. / AR No. -->
        <col style="width: 8.0%;">  <!-- 5. Mfg. Date -->
        <col style="width: 8.0%;">  <!-- 6. Exp. / Retest Date -->
        <col style="width: 9.5%;">  <!-- 7. Transfer Qty -->
        <col style="width: 8.5%;">  <!-- 8. Unit Rate (Rs.) -->
        <col style="width: 11.0%;"> <!-- 9. Taxable / Stock Value (Rs.) -->
    </colgroup>
    <thead>
        <tr>
            <th class="text-center">Sr.</th>
            <th style="text-align: left;">Material Description & Item Code</th>
            <th class="text-center">HSN / SAC</th>
            <th class="text-center">Batch No. / AR No.</th>
            <th class="text-center">Mfg.<br>Date</th>
            <th class="text-center">Exp. /<br>Retest</th>
            <th class="text-right">Qty.<br>({{ 'UOM' if is_mixed_uom else def_uom }})</th>
            <th class="text-right">Rate<br>(Rs.)</th>
            <th class="text-right">Value<br>(Rs.)</th>
        </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
        {% set ns = namespace(tot_qty=0.0, tot_val=0.0, hsn_map={}, batch_count=0) %}
        {% if doc.items %}
            {% for row in doc.items %}
                {% set i_code = row.get('item_code') or '-' %}
                {% set i_name = row.get('item_name') or i_code %}
                {% set r_uom = row.get('uom') or def_uom %}
                {% set qty = (row.get('qty') or 0.0) | float %}

                {# Valuation & Taxable Value Resolution (`taxable_value`, `amount`, `basic_amount`, `valuation_rate`) #}
                {% set raw_rate = (row.get('basic_rate') or row.get('valuation_rate') or 0.0) | float %}
                {% set row_val = (row.get('taxable_value') or row.get('amount') or row.get('basic_amount') or (qty * raw_rate)) | float %}
                {% set eff_rate = (row_val / qty) if (qty and qty != 0) else raw_rate %}

                {# HSN/SAC Resolution with Item Master Fallback #}
                {% set hsn = (row.get('gst_hsn_code') or '') | string | trim %}
                {% if not hsn and i_code != '-' and frappe.db.exists("Item", i_code) %}
                    {% set hsn = (frappe.db.get_value("Item", i_code, "gst_hsn_code") or '-') | string | trim %}
                {% endif %}
                {% if not hsn %}{% set hsn = '-' %}{% endif %}

                {# Row-level tax tracking if header taxes table is empty #}
                {% if not doc.get('taxes') %}
                    {% set r_cg = (row.get('cgst_amount') or 0.0) | float %}
                    {% set r_sg = (row.get('sgst_amount') or 0.0) | float %}
                    {% set r_ig = (row.get('igst_amount') or 0.0) | float %}
                    {% set r_cs = ((row.get('cess_amount') or 0.0) | float) + ((row.get('cess_non_advol_amount') or 0.0) | float) %}
                    {% set gst_ns.cg_amt = gst_ns.cg_amt + r_cg %}
                    {% set gst_ns.sg_amt = gst_ns.sg_amt + r_sg %}
                    {% set gst_ns.ig_amt = gst_ns.ig_amt + r_ig %}
                    {% set gst_ns.cess_amt = gst_ns.cess_amt + r_cs %}
                    {% set gst_ns.tot_tax = gst_ns.tot_tax + r_cg + r_sg + r_ig + r_cs %}
                {% endif %}

                {% set ns.tot_qty = ns.tot_qty + qty %}
                {% set ns.tot_val = ns.tot_val + row_val %}

                {# Update HSN Summary Map #}
                {% set h_entry = ns.hsn_map.get(hsn, {'qty': 0.0, 'amt': 0.0, 'uoms': []}) %}
                {% set h_uoms = h_entry.uoms + ([r_uom] if r_uom not in h_entry.uoms else []) %}
                {% set _ = ns.hsn_map.update({hsn: {'qty': h_entry.qty + qty, 'amt': h_entry.amt + row_val, 'uoms': h_uoms}}) %}

                {# 3-Tier GxP Batch Extraction (`Serial and Batch Bundle` -> `row.batch_no` -> `Stock Ledger Entry`) #}
                {% set b_ns = namespace(batches=[]) %}

                {# Tier 1: Direct Serial and Batch Bundle on Stock Entry Detail #}
                {% set sbb_id = row.get('serial_and_batch_bundle') %}
                {% if sbb_id and frappe.db.exists("Serial and Batch Bundle", sbb_id) %}
                    {% set sbb_doc = frappe.get_doc("Serial and Batch Bundle", sbb_id) %}
                    {% for e in sbb_doc.entries %}
                        {% if e.get('batch_no') %}
                            {% set b_ns.batches = b_ns.batches + [{"batch_no": e.batch_no | string | trim, "qty": e.qty | float | abs}] %}
                        {% endif %}
                    {% endfor %}
                {% endif %}

                {# Tier 2: Direct `batch_no` on Stock Entry Detail #}
                {% if not b_ns.batches and row.get('batch_no') %}
                    {% set b_ns.batches = b_ns.batches + [{"batch_no": row.batch_no | string | trim, "qty": qty}] %}
                {% endif %}

                {# Tier 3: Stock Ledger Entry / Voucher Detail Lookup #}
                {% if not b_ns.batches and row.get('name') %}
                    {% set sle_sbb = frappe.db.get_value("Serial and Batch Bundle", {"voucher_detail_no": row.name, "is_cancelled": 0}, "name") %}
                    {% if sle_sbb and frappe.db.exists("Serial and Batch Bundle", sle_sbb) %}
                        {% set sbb_obj = frappe.get_doc("Serial and Batch Bundle", sle_sbb) %}
                        {% for e in sbb_obj.entries %}
                            {% if e.get('batch_no') %}
                                {% set b_ns.batches = b_ns.batches + [{"batch_no": e.batch_no | string | trim, "qty": e.qty | float | abs}] %}
                            {% endif %}
                        {% endfor %}
                    {% endif %}
                {% endif %}

                {% set batches = b_ns.batches | sort(attribute='batch_no') %}
                {% set ns.batch_count = ns.batch_count + (batches | length if batches else 1) %}

                {# Render Multi-Batch Split Rows with Exact Paisa Reconciliation #}
                {% if batches | length > 1 %}
                    {% set b_sum = namespace(run_amt=0.0, run_qty=0.0) %}
                    {% for b in batches %}
                        {% set calc_amt = (b.qty * eff_rate) | round(2) %}
                        {% set b_sum.run_qty = b_sum.run_qty + b.qty %}
                        {% if loop.last and ((b_sum.run_qty - qty) | abs < 0.001) %}
                            {% set b_row_amt = (row_val - b_sum.run_amt) | round(2) %}
                        {% else %}
                            {% set b_row_amt = calc_amt %}
                            {% set b_sum.run_amt = b_sum.run_amt + b_row_amt %}
                        {% endif %}

                        {% set b_meta = frappe.db.get_value("Batch", b.batch_no, ["custom_ar_number", "custom_vendor_batch_number", "manufacturing_date", "expiry_date"], as_dict=1) if frappe.db.exists("Batch", b.batch_no) else None %}
                        {% set ar_no = (b_meta.get("custom_ar_number") or "") if b_meta else "" %}
                        {% set v_batch = (b_meta.get("custom_vendor_batch_number") or "") if b_meta else "" %}
                        {% set mfg_dt = frappe.utils.getdate(b_meta.manufacturing_date).strftime('%m/%Y') if (b_meta and b_meta.get("manufacturing_date")) else '-' %}
                        {% set exp_dt = frappe.utils.getdate(b_meta.expiry_date).strftime('%m/%Y') if (b_meta and b_meta.get("expiry_date")) else '-' %}
                        <tr>
                            <td class="text-center nowrap" style="font-weight: 600;">{{ row.idx ~ '.' ~ loop.index }}</td>
                            <td>
                                <strong>{{ i_name }}</strong> <span style="color:#555; font-size: 7.3pt;">({{ i_code }})</span>
                            </td>
                            <td class="text-center nowrap">{{ hsn }}</td>
                            <td class="text-center nowrap">
                                <span class="batch-code">{{ b.batch_no }}</span>
                                {% if ar_no %}<br><span style="color:#222; font-size: 6.9pt; font-weight: 600;">AR: {{ ar_no }}</span>{% endif %}
                                {% if not ar_no and v_batch %}<br><span style="color:#555; font-size: 6.8pt;">V.Batch: {{ v_batch }}</span>{% endif %}
                            </td>
                            <td class="text-center nowrap">{{ mfg_dt }}</td>
                            <td class="text-center nowrap">{{ exp_dt }}</td>
                            <td class="text-right num-col"><strong>{{ "{:,.3f}".format(b.qty) if (b.qty % 1 != 0) else "{:,.2f}".format(b.qty) }}{% if is_mixed_uom %} {{ r_uom }}{% endif %}</strong></td>
                            <td class="text-right num-col">{{ "{:,.2f}".format(eff_rate) }}</td>
                            <td class="text-right num-col"><strong>{{ "{:,.2f}".format(b_row_amt) }}</strong></td>
                        </tr>
                    {% endfor %}
                {% else %}
                    {% set single_b = batches[0].batch_no if batches else (row.get('batch_no') or '') %}
                    {% set b_meta = frappe.db.get_value("Batch", single_b, ["custom_ar_number", "custom_vendor_batch_number", "manufacturing_date", "expiry_date"], as_dict=1) if (single_b and frappe.db.exists("Batch", single_b)) else None %}
                    {% set ar_no = (b_meta.get("custom_ar_number") or "") if b_meta else "" %}
                    {% set v_batch = (b_meta.get("custom_vendor_batch_number") or "") if b_meta else "" %}
                    {% set mfg_dt = frappe.utils.getdate(b_meta.manufacturing_date).strftime('%m/%Y') if (b_meta and b_meta.get("manufacturing_date")) else '-' %}
                    {% set exp_dt = frappe.utils.getdate(b_meta.expiry_date).strftime('%m/%Y') if (b_meta and b_meta.get("expiry_date")) else '-' %}
                    <tr>
                        <td class="text-center nowrap"><strong>{{ row.idx }}</strong></td>
                        <td>
                            <strong>{{ i_name }}</strong> <span style="color:#555; font-size: 7.3pt;">({{ i_code }})</span>
                        </td>
                        <td class="text-center nowrap">{{ hsn }}</td>
                        <td class="text-center nowrap">
                            <span class="batch-code">{{ single_b if single_b else '-' }}</span>
                            {% if ar_no %}<br><span style="color:#222; font-size: 6.9pt; font-weight: 600;">AR: {{ ar_no }}</span>{% endif %}
                            {% if not ar_no and v_batch %}<br><span style="color:#555; font-size: 6.8pt;">V.Batch: {{ v_batch }}</span>{% endif %}
                        </td>
                        <td class="text-center nowrap">{{ mfg_dt }}</td>
                        <td class="text-center nowrap">{{ exp_dt }}</td>
                        <td class="text-right num-col"><strong>{{ "{:,.3f}".format(qty) if (qty % 1 != 0) else "{:,.2f}".format(qty) }}{% if is_mixed_uom %} {{ r_uom }}{% endif %}</strong></td>
                        <td class="text-right num-col">{{ "{:,.2f}".format(eff_rate) }}</td>
                        <td class="text-right num-col"><strong>{{ "{:,.2f}".format(row_val) }}</strong></td>
                    </tr>
                {% endif %}
            {% endfor %}

            {# Post-Item Remarks & Gate Pass Instructions Row #}
            {% set rem_text = (doc.get('remarks') or '') | string | trim %}
            {% set gp_instr = (doc.get('ge_gate_pass_instruction') or '') | string | trim %}
            {% if (rem_text and (rem_text | upper) not in ['NO REMARKS', 'NONE', '-']) or gp_instr %}
                <tr class="remarks-row">
                    <td></td>
                    <td colspan="8">
                        {% if gp_instr %}
                        <div class="remarks-grid" style="margin-bottom: 2px;">
                            <div class="remarks-lbl-cell">Gate Pass:</div>
                            <div class="remarks-val-cell">{{ gp_instr | replace('\n', '<br>') }}</div>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                        {% if rem_text and (rem_text | upper) not in ['NO REMARKS', 'NONE', '-'] %}
                        <div class="remarks-grid">
                            <div class="remarks-lbl-cell">Remarks:</div>
                            <div class="remarks-val-cell">{{ rem_text | replace('\n', '<br>') }}</div>
                        </div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                </tr>
            {% endif %}

            <tr style="background-color: #f0f3f6; font-weight: bold;">
                <td colspan="6" class="text-right">
